fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/ListingPages/PopularTruck.cy.js#ListingPages - NewListingPages [popularTrucks] [en] — Popular Truck TC-NLP-10: truck listing, filters and cards on Popular Truck
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-NLP-10
**Title:** truck listing, filters and cards on Popular Truck
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Confirm the truck listing block on Popular Truck shows a count heading, the Filter By row, and at least one truck card CTA.

**Expected Result:**
Listing heading with a count, Filter By / Reset All / Apply Filter, and at least one card button are visible.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Popular Truck listing page
2. Verify the listing heading
3. Verify Filter By controls
4. Verify at least one “Check Truck Price” card button
